title: Healthy Popsicles for Babies and Kids
summary: Delicious and healthy popsicle made with fruit and veggies. The perfect size for babies and toddlers.
steps: Add all the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into the molds of a madeleine cookie tin, ice pop molds or large ice cube trays.
Add a popsicle stick into each popsicle.
